title: History 1: GANs, the adversarial game (2014)
hook: Two networks play a game whose exact answer is a density ratio and a value of minus log 4. Then a real GAN trained on a CPU shows how far training gets from the theory.

The docstring says it is based on hifi-gan and supports HiFi-GAN and BigVGAN v2.
The class exists in the ACE vocoder file.
Upscale files are loaded through spandrel.
Tiles start at 512, halve on out of memory, and the node raises the error below 128.
The value of the game, the two gradients and the four small GANs print as shown.
